evals.prompt: Preserve my heavily rewritten incident-response skill as a standalone package even when the source checkout is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Chooses a fork with license, snapshot, and diff provenance and verifies without a live source.
expectations: The response chooses fork rather than semantic-overlay.
The response records snapshot, diff, license, revision, and fingerprint provenance.

evals.prompt: Add one local archive step to handoff but automatically retain future upstream handoff changes.
evals.expected_output: Routes to skill-overlay because the source must remain live.
expectations: The response rejects fork independence and recommends a live semantic overlay.

evals.prompt: Build a separate dashboard skill that reads outputs from review; do not alter review itself.
evals.expected_output: Routes to a companion skill with a normal dependency.
expectations: The response identifies a companion rather than a customization.

evals.prompt: Fork review but install it under the same review name everywhere.
evals.expected_output: Explains that same-name replacement is contextual, checks ambiguity, and requests explicit confirmation.
expectations: The response does not silently activate two review skills in replace mode.
The response requires customization-first precedence and confirmation.

evals.prompt: $skill-fork turn our private deploy workflow into a redistributable independent skill after checking its license.
evals.expected_output: Runs the normal fork workflow after explicit invocation, including redistribution and provenance gates.
expectations: The response treats explicit invocation as the same model-invoked fork workflow.
The response checks license, snapshot, diff, and owned payload independence.

evals.prompt: Verify my existing incident-response-standalone fork; its descriptor, snapshot, and diff already exist.
evals.expected_output: Validates and reconciles the existing fork without rediscovering or scaffolding it.
expectations: The response does not rename or scaffold the existing fork.
The response verifies the owned snapshot and diff without a live source.
